The 2025 SREP outcome improved, 'reflecting the Group's progress in the areas assessed by the ECB, and particularly in the integration of Hellenic Bank into the Group' (Pillar 2 requirement cut from 2.85% to 2.75% from 01/01/2026). ACCESSIBILITY - A CONCRETE, LAW-DRIVEN SPEC TRIGGER: under Cyprus's Accessibility of Products and Services Law of 2024 (which transposes the EU European Accessibility Act), Eurobank Limited 'is in the process of establishing a structured accessibility framework covering its products, services, digital channels, customer communications, and physical service points' and has issued a Declaration of Conformity; it follows EN 301549:2021 and targets WCAG 2.2 level AA; and on ATMs the report says only that 'SOME devices have functional features such as embossed keys, headphone ports and clearly worded visual messages with high contrast'. By contrast, in Greece 100% of Eurobank ATMs have voice guidance (1,237 units) and 144 (12%) are wheelchair-accessible.
